description:
Sherry FitzGerald Radford is delighted to bring to the market this exceptionally well-presented detached home, superbly situated on the outskirts of the village of Taghmon and just a 10-minute drive from Wexford Town.

Originally a much-loved family home, the property has been completely transformed by the current owners over the past four years. With considerable care, investment and attention to detail, they have seamlessly married the original cottage with a beautifully designed extension, creating a warm, contemporary and highly functional home that combines character with all the comforts of modern living.

Presented with considerable flair, the house has been comprehensively renovated and upgraded throughout. The works include a stunning open-plan kitchen/dining room, quality sanitary ware, a stylish ensuite, new plumbing and electrics, flooring, doors and windows, together with numerous other improvements that have resulted in a home of exceptional presentation and comfort.

The accommodation briefly comprises an entrance hall, shower room, three bedrooms, main ensuite, living room, rear hall and impressive open-plan kitchen/dining room. The house has been thoughtfully designed to maximise both natural light and everyday functionality, while retaining the charm and character of the original dwelling including high ceilings.

Set on approximately 0.89 acres, the property enjoys generous grounds with excellent potential for those seeking additional space and privacy. The gardens are predominantly laid in lawn and are beautifully enclosed by mature hedging and established trees, creating a wonderfully private and secluded setting. There is also extensive off-street parking surrounding the property.

The property had planning permission granted in 2009 for an additional house on the site. This permission has now lapsed; however, the generous site may offer potential for future development, subject to the necessary planning permission and the purchaser satisfying themselves in this regard.

The location is particularly appealing. Taghmon village is close by for everyday amenities, while Wexford Town is approximately 10 minutes away by car. The property's position also provides easy access to the main routes serving Dublin, Waterford and beyond. For those who enjoy the coast, the beautiful beaches and coastal amenities of Kilmore Quay, Duncannon and Bannow Bay are all within easy driving distance.
